cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(lmx_control_extra LANGUAGES C)
    set(LMX_CONTROL_EXTRA_STANDALONE ON)
    enable_testing()
endif()
set(LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../vendor")
set(LMX_CONTROL_DEPENDENCY_VENDOR "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}" CACHE PATH "Existing compact collection vendor directory with libfixmath/libfixmatrix")
option(LMX_CONTROL_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS "Build offline control/protocol checks" ${LMX_CONTROL_EXTRA_STANDALONE})
if(NOT COMMAND lmx_c99_target)
    function(lmx_c99_target target)
        get_target_property(_type ${target} TYPE)
        if(_type STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
            target_compile_features(${target} INTERFACE c_std_99)
        else()
            set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
            if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
                target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
            endif()
        endif()
    endfunction()
endif()

if(NOT TARGET LMX::fixmath)
    file(GLOB _fixmath_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${LMX_CONTROL_DEPENDENCY_VENDOR}/libfixmath/libfixmath/*.c")
    add_library(lmx_fixmath STATIC ${_fixmath_sources})
    add_library(LMX::fixmath ALIAS lmx_fixmath)
    target_include_directories(lmx_fixmath PUBLIC "${LMX_CONTROL_DEPENDENCY_VENDOR}/libfixmath/libfixmath")
    target_compile_definitions(lmx_fixmath PUBLIC FIXMATH_NO_CACHE)
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_fixmath)
    if(UNIX)
        target_link_libraries(lmx_fixmath PUBLIC m)
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT TARGET LMX::fixmatrix)
    add_library(lmx_fixmatrix STATIC "${LMX_CONTROL_DEPENDENCY_VENDOR}/libfixmatrix/fixmatrix.c" "${LMX_CONTROL_DEPENDENCY_VENDOR}/libfixmatrix/fixarray.c")
    add_library(LMX::fixmatrix ALIAS lmx_fixmatrix)
    target_include_directories(lmx_fixmatrix PUBLIC "${LMX_CONTROL_DEPENDENCY_VENDOR}/libfixmatrix")
    target_link_libraries(lmx_fixmatrix PUBLIC LMX::fixmath)
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_fixmatrix)
endif()

file(GLOB _fusion_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/fusion/Fusion/*.c")
add_library(lmx_fusion STATIC ${_fusion_sources})
add_library(LMX::fusion ALIAS lmx_fusion)
target_include_directories(lmx_fusion PUBLIC "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/fusion/Fusion")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_fusion PUBLIC FUSION_USE_NORMAL_SQRT FUSION_NO_INLINE)
lmx_c99_target(lmx_fusion)
if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_fusion PUBLIC m)
endif()

add_library(lmx_fixkalman STATIC "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/fixkalman/fixkalman.c")
add_library(LMX::fixkalman ALIAS lmx_fixkalman)
target_include_directories(lmx_fixkalman PUBLIC "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/fixkalman")
target_link_libraries(lmx_fixkalman PUBLIC LMX::fixmatrix)
lmx_c99_target(lmx_fixkalman)

include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/prepare_pid.cmake")
add_library(lmx_pid STATIC "${LMX_PID_BUILD_SOURCE}")
add_library(LMX::pid ALIAS lmx_pid)
target_include_directories(lmx_pid PUBLIC "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/pid")
lmx_c99_target(lmx_pid)

add_library(lmx_canard STATIC "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/libcanard/libcanard/canard.c")
add_library(LMX::canard ALIAS lmx_canard)
target_include_directories(lmx_canard PUBLIC "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/libcanard/libcanard" PRIVATE "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/libcanard/lib/cavl2")
lmx_c99_target(lmx_canard)

add_library(lmx_nanomodbus STATIC "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/nanomodbus/nanomodbus.c")
add_library(LMX::nanomodbus ALIAS lmx_nanomodbus)
target_include_directories(lmx_nanomodbus PUBLIC "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/nanomodbus")
lmx_c99_target(lmx_nanomodbus)

include("${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/coremqtt/mqttFilePaths.cmake")
add_library(lmx_coremqtt STATIC ${MQTT_SOURCES} ${MQTT_SERIALIZER_SOURCES})
add_library(LMX::coremqtt ALIAS lmx_coremqtt)
target_include_directories(lmx_coremqtt PUBLIC ${MQTT_INCLUDE_PUBLIC_DIRS})
target_compile_definitions(lmx_coremqtt PUBLIC MQTT_DO_NOT_USE_CUSTOM_CONFIG)
lmx_c99_target(lmx_coremqtt)

file(GLOB _lwip_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/lwip/src/core/*.c"
    "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/lwip/src/core/ipv4/*.c"
    "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/lwip/src/core/ipv6/*.c")
add_library(lmx_lwip STATIC ${_lwip_sources} "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/lwip/src/netif/ethernet.c")
add_library(LMX::lwip ALIAS lmx_lwip)
set(LMX_LWIP_PORT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/port/lwip" CACHE PATH "lwIP NO_SYS configuration and arch port")
target_include_directories(lmx_lwip PUBLIC "${LMX_LWIP_PORT_DIR}" "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/lwip/src/include")
lmx_c99_target(lmx_lwip)

add_library(lmx_control_extra INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::control_extra ALIAS lmx_control_extra)
target_link_libraries(lmx_control_extra INTERFACE LMX::fusion LMX::fixkalman LMX::pid LMX::canard LMX::nanomodbus LMX::coremqtt LMX::lwip)
lmx_c99_target(lmx_control_extra)

if(LMX_CONTROL_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    foreach(_name fusion pid canard nanomodbus coremqtt lwip)
        add_executable(lmx_control_test_${_name} "tests/test_${_name}.c")
        target_link_libraries(lmx_control_test_${_name} PRIVATE LMX::${_name})
        lmx_c99_target(lmx_control_test_${_name})
        if(UNIX)
            target_link_libraries(lmx_control_test_${_name} PRIVATE m)
        endif()
        add_test(NAME control_extra.${_name} COMMAND lmx_control_test_${_name})
    endforeach()
    add_executable(lmx_control_test_fixkalman "${LMX_CONTROL_VENDOR}/fixkalman/test_package/main.c")
    target_link_libraries(lmx_control_test_fixkalman PRIVATE LMX::fixkalman)
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_control_test_fixkalman)
    add_test(NAME control_extra.fixkalman COMMAND lmx_control_test_fixkalman)
endif()
